title: Sug: Change complex dates to relative ones.

replies.author: Spartemex
replies.body: On the forums, if you hover over the complex date, it will show "_ minutes ago". But, it would be cool to see this feature implemented with infractions. :)

replies.author: Mehrp
replies.body: Personally I think it's more complex, I prefer having a set date and so this would mean I'd have to work out what day it was :(

replies.author: SirCyaniide
replies.body:
+1  

I don't like having these infractions on a different time. This system will help prevent Mixups, and mistakes. It simplifies when he/she can get back on.

replies.author: _Stormz
replies.body: Times are pretty important, not just the dates. If a person gets temp banned for one day, he'll come back after that day. He won't know what time it will actually expire, so it might be a bit confusing for them since "about" isn't really accurate.
